error-linked-card-not-allowed: Ushobora guhuza gusa n'ikarita isanzwe. Guhuza n'indi karita ihujwe, cyangwa n'ikarita ihuza igaruka kuri iki kibaho, ntibyemewe kuko byatuma amakarita adashobora kugerwaho.
export-card-excel-fields: Hitamo imirima yo gushyira mu gusohora kwa Excel:
export-card-excel-no-disk-space: Ntibishoboka gusohora muri Excel: nta mwanya uhagije uri kuri disiki
user-can-not-export-card-to-pdf: Ukoresha ntashobora gusohora ikarita muri PDF
user-can-not-export-card-to-excel: Ukoresha ntashobora gusohora ikarita muri Excel
filter-date-range-invalid: Hitamo amatariki nyayo; itariki ya nyuma igomba kuba imwe n'iyo gutangira cyangwa ikaza nyuma yayo.
filter-due-any: Itariki iyo ari yo yose ntarengwa (harimo n'adafite itariki)
filter-column-age-disabled: Ntuhishe ukurikije igihe ikarita imaze mu rutonde
filter-column-age-hint: Hisha amakarita yinjiye muri uru rutonde hashize iminsi irenga uyu mubare. Izindi ntonde n'amakarita afite amatariki yo kwinjira atazwi bikomeza kugaragara. Guhindura ikarita ntibituma igihe imaze mu rutonde gitangira bundi bushya.
filter-on-desc: Urimo gushungura amakarita kuri iki kibaho. Kanda hano kugira uhindure akayunguruzo.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Shungura amatariki y'amakarita ukoresheje @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt cyangwa @listEnteredAt. Urugero: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' cyangwa @endAt = none. Shyira izina ry'umwanya wihariye ritangirwa na @ hagati y'utwuguruzo n'utwugarizo.
advanced-filter-description: Akayunguruzo Gateye Imbere kagufasha kwandika inyandiko irimo abakoresha bakurikira: == != <= >= && || ( ) Umwanya ukoreshwa nk'igitandukanya hagati y'Abakoresha. Ushobora gushungura Imirima Yihariye yose wandika amazina n'indangagaciro byayo. Urugero: Field1 == Value1. Icyitonderwa: Niba imirima cyangwa indangagaciro birimo imyanya, ugomba kubishyira hagati y'utwuguruzo tumwe. Urugero: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kugira ibimenyetso bigenzura kimwe (' \/) bisimbukwe, ushobora gukoresha \. Urugero: Field1 == I\'m. Ushobora kandi guhuza ibisabwa byinshi. Urugero: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ubusanzwe abakoresha bose basobanurwa kuva ibumoso bajya iburyo. Ushobora guhindura urutonde ushyiraho udukubo. Urugero: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ushobora kandi gushakisha imirima y'inyandiko ukoresheje regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Bihura igihe ikarita iremwe, cyangwa umutwe wayo cyangwa ibisobanuro byayo bihinduwe, kandi umwandiko mushya ukubiyemo ibi (inyuguti nini n'intoya ntibitaho).
imported-member-no-account: Umunyamuryango winjijwe — nta konti ihuye na we
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Nimanika JSON yasohowe na Kanboard: ikintu gifite "columns" (cyangwa ibikorwa bifite column_name) n'urutonde rwa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Inkingi ziba intonde, ibikorwa bikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-deck: Nimanika JSON y'ikibaho cya NextCloud Deck (ikibaho gifite "stacks", buri stack ifite "cards" zayo). Stacks ziba intonde, cards zikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Nimanika JSON y'ikusanyirizo rya work-packages rya OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses ziba intonde, work packages zikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-issues: Nimanika urutonde JSON rw'ibibazo bya __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ibibazo biba amakarita ashyizwe mu ntonde Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Nimanika JSON yasohowe y'ibikorwa bya Asana ({ "data": [...] } ivuye mu gusohora kwa Asana cyangwa GET /tasks). Ibikorwa bishyirwa mu bice (memberships); ibyuzuye bijya muri Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Nimanika JSON yasohowe y'urutonde rwa ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages ziba intonde, items zikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Nimanika urutonde rw'imirimo rwa markdown (uburyo ibikoresho bya markdown-kanban nka Obsidian Kanban bikoresha): imitwe "## Izina ry'urutonde", hamwe n'ibintu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" munsi yayo. Imitwe iba intonde kandi ibintu bikaba amakarita; urutonde rusanzwe rw'utudomo rudafite utuzu two guhitamo na rwo rurinjizwa, nk'amakarita afunguye.
import-board-instruction-leo: Omekaho imiterere ya Leo (dosiye .leo). Ibice byo ku rwego rwo hejuru bihinduka intonde, ibice bibikomokaho ku rwego rukurikira bigahinduka amakarita, kandi inyandiko y'igice ikaba ibisobanuro by'ikarita. Ibice biri ku nzego zimbitse kurushaho bihinduka intonde zo kugenzura. Ibice byashyizweho ikimenyetso byinjizwa nk'ibyarangiye.
import-board-instruction-opml: Shyiramo incamake ya OPML, nk'uko Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq n'izindi porogaramu z'incamake ziyisohora. Ibintu byo hejuru biba intonde, ibibikomokaho biba amakarita afite inyandiko nk'ibisobanuro, naho ibintu byimbitse kurushaho biba intonde zo kugenzura. Ibintu byarangiye byinjizwa nk'ibyakozwe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Shyiramo dosiye ya Org mode, nk'uko Emacs, Orgzly cyangwa Beorg ziyandika. Imitwe yo ku rwego rwa mbere iba intonde naho imitwe yo ku rwego rwa kabiri iba amakarita. TODO na DONE, ibyihutirwa, ibimenyetso, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED birabikwa, naho udusanduku two gutoranya n'imitwe yimbitse kurushaho biba intonde zo kugenzura.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Komeka dosiye ya todo.txt: umurimo umwe kuri buri murongo, nk'uko porogaramu ya todo.txt n'izindi zijyanye na yo zibyandika. Imirimo yarangiye ("x") ijya mu Yarangiye, +project na @context bihinduka ibirango, (A) ihinduka ikirango cy'ibyihutirwa, naho due: na t: bigahinduka amatariki ntarengwa n'ayo gutangira.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Shyiramo ibisohoka muri task export: urutonde rwa JSON cyangwa igikorwa kimwe kuri buri murongo. Ibikorwa byarangiye bijya muri Done, project na priority bihinduka ibirango, annotations ihinduka ibitekerezo, naho depends ihinduka ukwishingikiriza ku bikorwa bibibuza gukomeza.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Fungura dosiye ya .boardarchive uyikure mu bubiko butsindagiye, hanyuma ushyiremo ibiri muri board.jsonl y’ikibaho, hamwe n’umurongo wa verisiyo cyangwa utawushyizemo. Ikiranga cyo gushyira mu matsinda mu isura y’ikibaho gihinduka intonde, ibindi biranga byo guhitamo bigahinduka ibirango, ibice by’inyandiko n’udusanduku two gushyiraho akamenyetso bigahinduka ibisobanuro n’urutonde rwo kugenzura, kandi ibitekerezo bikagumaho. Amashusho n’imigereka ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Muri MeisterTask, kanda ku izina ry'umushinga, hitamo Export project hanyuma usohore CSV, maze uyishyiremo. Ibice biba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'inyandiko zayo, itariki ntarengwa, uwahawe akazi n'ibimenyetso; imirimo yarangiye igumana itariki yarangiriyeho. CSV yandikiwe kwinjizwa muri MeisterTask nayo irakora.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Muri Obsidian, fungura dosiye y'ikibaho cya Kanban nka Markdown (cyangwa ufungure dosiye .md mu mwanditsi w'umwandiko), hanyuma uyishyiremo yose. Inzira ziba intonde zifite imipaka y'amakarita yazo, amakarita agumana ibimenyetso, amatariki, icyihutirwa, imyanya n'urutonde rwo kugenzura, naho Archive iba amakarita ari mu Bubiko.
import-board-instruction-linear: Muri Linear, sohora ibibazo nka CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, cyangwa isohora ry'igaragaza), hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Imiterere iba intonde, amatsinda aba imirongo, naho ibibazo biba amakarita hamwe n'uwahawe akazi, ibirango, amatariki, ikibazo kibikomokaho, icyihutirwa, igereranya, umushinga n'icyiciro.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Muri TickTick, fungura Settings, Account, Backup & Import maze ukore ububiko bw'inyunganizi, hanyuma ushyiremo dosiye ya CSV. Buri rutonde rwa TickTick ruba umurongo naho inkingi zarwo ziba intonde; imirimo igumana ibimenyetso, amatariki, urutonde rwo kugenzura, icyihutirwa n'ibikorwa bito.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Muri ClickUp, sohora imirimo nka CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, cyangwa isohora ry'igaragaza rya List cyangwa Table rifite inkingi zose), hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Imiterere iba intonde, intonde za ClickUp ziba imirongo, naho imirimo iba amakarita hamwe n'ibikorwa bito, abahawe akazi, ibimenyetso, amatariki, icyihutirwa n'igihe.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Muri Nullboard, fungura ikibaho, hitamo Export this board... muri menu, fungura dosiye .nbx mu mwanditsi w'umwandiko maze ushyiremo ibiyirimo. Intonde ziba intonde naho inyandiko ziba amakarita: umurongo wa mbere w'inyandiko ni umutwe w'ikarita naho ibisigaye ni ibisobanuro byayo. Inyandiko mbisi ihabwa ikirango raw. Dosiye ifite ibibaho byinshi yinjiza ikibaho cyayo cya mbere.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Muri Kanri, fungura Import & Export maze uhitemo Export individual board (cyangwa Export all data), hanyuma ushyiremo dosiye .json. Inkingi ziba intonde naho amakarita aba amakarita, hamwe n'ibisobanuro, itariki ntarengwa, ibimenyetso n'amabara; imirimo y'ikarita iba urutonde rwo kugenzura. Mu isohora ry'amakuru yose, ikibaho cya mbere ni cyo cyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Andika aderesi ya Planka yawe (urugero https://planka.example.com), izina ry'ukoresha n'ijambobanga rya Planka, hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa». Bikoreshwa gusa mu kuzana ikibaho kandi ntibibikwa. Hitamo ikibaho hanyuma ukande «Zana»: WeKan igisoma ivanye kuri API ya Planka hamwe n'intonde zacyo, amakarita, ibisobanuro, amatariki ntarengwa, ibirango, abanyamuryango, intonde z'imirimo n'ibitekerezo, hanyuma ukomeze kwinjiza nk'uko bisanzwe. Amakarita ari mu bubiko bwa Planka yinjizwa nk'ayashyizwe mu bubiko; imigereka n'amakarita ari mu myanda ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Muri Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), injira, wemere uruhushya rwa Tasks.Read hanyuma wigane token uvuye ku gice cya Access token. Yishyire hano hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa»; token ikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Hitamo intonde zose cyangwa rumwe hanyuma ukande «Zana». Buri rutonde rwa To Do ruhinduka urutonde na buri murimo ugahinduka ikarita, hamwe n'inyandiko, amatariki ntarengwa n'ayo gutangira, intambwe nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibyiciro nk'ibirango, akamaro kanini n'imiterere nk'ibirango; imirimo yarangiye ishyirwa mu bubiko. Ibyibutsa n'isubiramo ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Muri KanbanFlow, fungura menu y'ikibaho, hitamo Settings → API & Webhooks hanyuma wigane token ya API y'ikibaho. Shyira token hano, ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemo ikibaho hanyuma ukande «Zana»; token ikoreshwa gusa muri uko kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Inkingi zihinduka intonde, imirongo ikaguma imirongo; imirimo igumana ibisobanuro, ibara, ibirango, itariki ntarengwa, imirimo mito nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, igihe cyakoreshejwe, igereranya, abantu n'ibitekerezo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Andika ID ya konti yawe ya Basecamp (umubare uri nyuma ya basecamp.com/ muri aderesi) na token yo kwinjira (ivuye kuri porogaramu ya OAuth 2 yanditswe kuri launchpad.37signals.com, cyangwa iyo uguhuza gusanzwe gufite), ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemo umushinga hanyuma ukande «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri uko kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Buri mbonerahamwe y'amakarita ihinduka umurongo n'inkingi zayo nk'intonde, intonde z'ibyo gukora zigahinduka umurongo «To-dos»; amakarita n'ibyo gukora bigumana inyandiko, amatariki, abashinzwe n'ibitekerezo, intambwe z'ikarita zihinduka urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibyarangiye bigashyirwa mu bubiko.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Bona token yo kwinjira kuri OAuth 2.0 Playground: munsi ya Tasks API v1 hitamo tasks.readonly, kanda Authorize APIs, hanyuma Exchange authorization code for tokens, wigane token yo kwinjira. Yishyire hano hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemo intonde z'imirimo zose cyangwa rumwe, hanyuma «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Intonde z'imirimo zihinduka intonde, imirimo ikaba amakarita, hamwe n'inyandiko, imiyoboro n'itariki ntarengwa; imirimo mito ihinduka urutonde rwo kugenzura, imirimo yarangiye ikinjizwa nk'iyashyizwe mu bubiko.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ni iya konti za Google Workspace gusa. Bona token yo kwinjira ya OAuth 2.0 ifite urwego https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (muri OAuth 2.0 Playground niba umuyobozi wa Workspace yawe abyemera, cyangwa ivuye kuri konti ya serivisi ifite uburenganzira ku rubuga rwose), uyishyire, ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa» hanyuma «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Inyandiko z'amagambo zihinduka amakarita mu rutonde «Notes», inyandiko z'urutonde rwo kugenzura zigahinduka amakarita mu rutonde «Lists» n'ibintu byazo nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura. Inyandiko ziri mu myanda, imigereka no gusangira ntibyinjizwa.
api-import-desc: Bizane uvuye kuri serivisi ukoresheje konti yawe bwite. Ibyo wanditse hano bikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibibikwa.
api-import-fetched: Byazanywe. Reba abanyamuryango bari hepfo hanyuma winjize.
api-import-nothing: Nta kintu cyo kwinjiza kiri kuri iyi konti.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Muri Pivotal Tracker, fungura agace MORE k'umushinga maze uhitemo Export CSV (cyangwa uhitemo inkuru maze uhitemo Bulk Actions, CSV), hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Buri miterere y'inkuru iba urutonde naho inkuru ziba amakarita, hamwe n'ubwoko n'ibirango, ba nyirabyo, uwabisabye, amatariki, ibitekerezo, imirimo n'ibibangamira; Estimate iba Story points naho iterations ziba sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Muri Tasks.org, fungura Settings, Backups maze uhitemo Export tasks, hanyuma ushyiremo ibiri muri iyo dosiye .json. Intonde ziba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'inyandiko, ibimenyetso, amatariki, ibitekerezo n'ibikorwa bito; imirimo yarangiye igumana itariki yarangiriyeho, naho icyihutirwa kiba umwanya wihariye.
import-board-instruction-monday: Muri monday.com, fungura menu y'ikibaho, hitamo More actions na Export board to Excel (hamwe n'amakuru mashya n'ibice bito niba ubishaka), hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Inkingi ya Status iba intonde naho amatsinda aba imirongo; abantu, amatariki, igihe ngengabihe n'ibimenyetso bigumana imyanya yabyo, izindi nkingi ziba imyanya yihariye naho amakuru mashya aba ibitekerezo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Muri Super Productivity, fungura Settings, hanyuma Sync & Backup, hitamo Export Data maze ushyiremo ibiri muri dosiye sp-backup .json. Buri mushinga uba umurongo naho imirimo iba amakarita muri To Do, In Progress, Backlog cyangwa Done, hamwe n'inyandiko, ibimenyetso, itariki ntarengwa, igihe cyakoreshejwe n'ibikorwa bito; imirimo iri mu bubiko iba amakarita ari mu Bubiko.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Muri Taiga, fungura Admin > Project > Export maze umanure ububiko bw'umushinga (banza ufungure dosiye .json.gz), hanyuma ushyiremo JSON yayo. Imiterere y'inkuru z'abakoresha iba intonde, inkuru z'abakoresha ziba amakarita hamwe n'imirimo yazo nk'ibikorwa bito, epics n'ibibazo bihabwa imirongo yabyo, naho sprints, ibimenyetso, ibitekerezo n'ibiranga byihariye biraza. Imigereka ntiyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Muri Vikunja, fungura Settings, hitamo Data Export maze umanure dosiye .zip ikoherereza, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye, cyangwa ushyiremo data.json iyirimo. Ibiseke bya Kanban biba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'ibirango, abahawe akazi, amatariki, ibisobanuro, intonde z'imirimo nk'intonde zo kugenzura n'ibitekerezo; icyihutirwa, ijanisha ryakozwe na done biba imyanya yihariye. Imigereka ntiyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Muri Quire, fungura menu y'umushinga maze uhitemo Export CSV, hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Imiterere iba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'ibikorwa bito byayo nk'amakarita akomoka kuri yo, abahawe akazi, ibimenyetso nk'ibirango, amatariki yo gutangira, ntarengwa n'ayo kurangiza, ibisobanuro n'icyihutirwa nk'umwanya wihariye. Ibitekerezo n'imigereka ntibiri muri CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Muri Wrike, sohora umushinga cyangwa ububiko muri Excel, cyangwa wuzuze inyandikorugero ya Excel yo kwinjiza ya Wrike, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Imirongo y'ububiko n'imishinga iba imirongo, Status iba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe na Key yayo, umurimo uyikomokaho, abahawe akazi, amatariki yo gutangira n'ayo kurangiza, ibyo ishingiyeho n'ibisobanuro; Priority, Duration n'izindi nkingi biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Muri Teamwork.com, uzuza inyandikorugero ya Excel yo kwinjiza imirimo (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) maze uyibike nka .xlsx, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye. Intonde z'imirimo ziba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita; umurimo utangiwe na -, # cyangwa > uba igikorwa gito cy'umurimo uri hejuru yawo (--, ## cyangwa >> urwego rumwe rwimbitse kurushaho). Abahawe akazi, amatariki n'ibimenyetso bigumana imyanya yabyo; Priority, Estimated time na Complete biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Muri Businessmap (yahoze ari Kanbanize), fungura Advanced Search, hitamo Configure results kugira ngo utoranye inkingi, umanure dosiye ya Excel, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Inkingi zisomwa hakurikijwe amazina yazo y'Icyongereza (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): niba konti yawe ikoresha urundi rurimi, banza uhindure umurongo w'imitwe mu Cyongereza. Column iba intonde naho Lane iba imirongo; ba nyirabyo, ibimenyetso, ibara, amatariki, ibitekerezo n'amahuza y'ibikomokwaho bigumana imyanya yabyo, naho Priority, Size, Type n'izindi nkingi biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Muri Redmine, fungura Issues z'umushinga, hitamo Also available in: CSV hasi ku rutonde, toranya inkingi (All columns, hamwe na Description) maze usohore, hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Redmine yita inkingi mu rurimi rwawe, bityo shyira ururimi rwawe mu Cyongereza muri My account mbere yo gusohora. Buri miterere iba urutonde naho ibibazo biba amakarita, hamwe na tracker nk'ikirango, uwahawe akazi, umwanditsi, amatariki, umurimo ubikomokaho n'ibibazo bifitanye isano; icyihutirwa, icyiciro, verisiyo igamijwe, igihe giteganyijwe, % Done n'imyanya yihariye biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-notion: Muri Notion, fungura ububikoshingiro nk'urupapuro rwuzuye, hitamo ••• na Export, toranya Markdown & CSV, maze uhitemo dosiye .zip imanurwa, cyangwa CSV imwe y'ububikoshingiro iyirimo, cyangwa ushyiremo iyo CSV. Inkingi yitwa Status iba intonde (niba itariho, inkingi ya mbere isa n'iyo guhitamo ni yo iba intonde, kandi raporo yo kwinjiza ivuga iyo ari yo); imirongo iba amakarita hamwe n'umutwe wayo, ibimenyetso nk'ibirango, abantu nk'abanyamuryango, amatariki, n'umwandiko w'urupapuro nk'ibisobanuro; izindi nkingi ziba imyanya yihariye. Isano, amashusho n'imigereka ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Muri Plane, fungura Workspace Settings, hitamo Exports, sohora imishinga nka JSON, CSV cyangwa Excel maze umanure dosiye .zip, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye, cyangwa dosiye imwe iyirimo, cyangwa ushyiremo JSON cyangwa CSV. Imiterere iba intonde, imishinga iba imirongo, naho ibibazo biba amakarita hamwe n'ikiranga cyabyo, ibibikomokaho, abahawe akazi, ibirango, amatariki, amahuza n'ibitekerezo; icyihutirwa, igereranya, icyiciro na module biba imyanya yihariye. Isohora rya Plane nta bisobanuro cyangwa imigereka rifite, bityo ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ku kibaho cyawe cya Trello, jya kuri 'Menu', hanyuma 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', maze ukope inyandiko ivuyemo.
import-board-instruction-csv: Nimanika Indangagaciro Zitandukanyijwe n'Akitso (CSV)/ Indangagaciro Zitandukanyijwe na Tab (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Nimanika JSON ivuye mu gushakisha ibibazo kwa Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), cyangwa ikintu gihwanye na { "issues": [...] }. Gusohora kwandika intonde z'iki kibaho nk'urumwe, rwitiriwe ikibaho, muri JSON API ya Wrike isubiza ku rujya n'uruza rw'akazi: kora urwo rujya n'uruza muri Wrike mbere yo kwinjiza isohora rya Excel rya Wrike ry'ikibaho, kugira ngo imiterere yarwo ikoreshwe. Kwinjiza gusoma iyo JSON yashyizwe hejuru, ivuye muri WeKan cyangwa muri GET /workflows ya Wrike, ikayishyira ku kibaho cyatoranyijwe: imiterere idafite urutonde iba urutonde, kandi itegeko rishyira ikarita nk'iyarangiye iyo yimuriwe mu miterere ya Completed cyangwa Cancelled, n'iyitarangiye mu ya Active cyangwa Deferred. Amategeko y'ikoresha-ryikora ya Wrike ubwayo ntashobora gusohorwa muri Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Ishakisha rishobora kubamo opereteri kugira ngo risobanuke neza. Opereteri zigaragazwa no kwandika izina rya opereteri n'agaciro bitandukanyijwe n'utudomo tubiri. Urugero, `list:Blocked` yatuma ishakisha rigarukira ku makarita ari mu rutonde rwitwa *Blocked*. Niba agaciro karimo imyanya cyangwa ibimenyetso byihariye kagomba gushyirwa mu twuguruzo (urugero `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - amakarita ari ku bibaho bihuye na *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - amakarita ari mu ntonde zihuye na *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - amakarita ari mu mirongo ihuye na *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - amakarita afite akamenyetso gahuye na *<color>* cyangwa *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amakarita ari ku kibaho cyahawe ikigo *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amakarita ari ku kibaho cyahawe itsinda *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amakarita azageza ku gihe mu minsi itarenze *<n>* kuva ubu. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ yerekana amakarita yose yarengeje igihe cyo kurangira.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amakarita yakozwe mu minsi *<n>* ishize cyangwa munsi yayo
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amakarita yahinduwe mu minsi *<n>* ishize cyangwa munsi yayo
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - aho *<status>* ari kimwe muri ibi bikurikira:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - amakarita yose, ari mu bubiko n'atari mu bubiko
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - amakarita ari ku bibaho rusange gusa
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - amakarita ari ku bibaho bwite gusa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - aho *<field>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` cyangwa `__predicate_member__`. Gushyira `-` imbere ya *<field>* bishakisha aho uwo murima udafite agaciro (urugero `has:-due` ishakisha amakarita adafite itariki yo kurangira).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - aho *<sort-name>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` cyangwa `__predicate_modified__`. Kugira ngo bitondekwe mu buryo bugabanuka, shyira `-` imbere y'izina ry'itondeka.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - aho *<n>* ari umubare wuzuye uruta zeru ugaragaza umubare w'amakarita yerekanwa kuri buri paji.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Opereteri zisa zihuzwa na *OR*. Amakarita ahuye na kimwe mu bisabwa aragaragazwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` yagaragaza amakarita ari mu rutonde urwo ari rwo rwose rwitwa *Blocked* cyangwa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Opereteri zitandukanye zihuzwa na *AND*. Hagaragazwa gusa amakarita ahuye na opereteri zose zitandukanye. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` igaragaza gusa amakarita ari mu rutonde *Available* afite akamenyetso *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Iminsi ishobora gutangwa nk'umubare wuzuye uruta cyangwa uri munsi ya zeru, cyangwa hakoreshejwe `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` cyangwa `__predicate_year__` ku gihe turimo.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Ishakisha ry'amagambo ntirita ku nyuguti nkuru cyangwa nto.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Mu buryo busanzwe, amakarita ari mu bubiko ntashakishwa.

database-migration-description: Imura amakuru ashingiye ku mwandiko (byose uretse imigereka n'amashusho y'imyirondoro biguma kuri sisitemu ya dosiye) hagati ya MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Ubundi bubikoshingiro bugomba kuba burimo gukora kandi bugerwaho (ibyambu bisanzwe: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; hindura ukoresheje WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Birangiye, erekeza MONGO_URL ku bundi bubikoshingiro maze wongere utangire WeKan (kuri Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb cyangwa =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Imurira amakuru y'umwandiko muri FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Kopororera amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku mwandiko muri __db__? Imigereka n'amashusho y'imyirondoro biri kuri sisitemu ya dosiye ntibihinduka. Ububikoshingiro bugenewe kwakira bugomba kuba burimo gukora.
sandstorm-migration-description: Iyo WeKan ikorera muri grain ya Sandstorm, ububikoshingiro bwayo bwa kera bwa MongoDB 3 bwimurirwa muri FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ku itangira rya mbere, kandi imigereka n'amashusho y'imyirondoro bikavanwa mu bubikoshingiro bikimurirwa mu bubiko files/attachments na files/avatars bwa grain. Ibi byerekana niba uko kwimura kwaragenze neza n'umwanya dosiye mbisi za kera za MongoDB zigikoresha kuri disiki muri grain, kandi bikagufasha gusiba izo dosiye mbisi kugira ngo ubone umwanya.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Siba dosiye mbisi z'ububikoshingiro bwa MongoDB

features-desc: Ibiranga by'inyongera iyi WeKan itanga. Ikiranga kitashyizweho akamenyetso gihishwa ku mugaragarire wa buri wese. Amakuru yacyo arabikwa kandi uburenganzira ntibuhinduka.
feature-views-overview-desc: Imibare, gushyira mu matsinda hakurikijwe uwahawe inshingano, gahunda y'inzira, ikibaho cy'igenzura n'ikibaho kinini.

card-field-visibility-desc: Imyanya ya Igenamiterere ry'Ikibaho / Ikarita ibibaho bishobora kwerekana. Umwanya udatoranyijwe uhishwa ku ikarita yose, ikarita ntoya yose na Igenamiterere ry'Ikibaho / Ikarita by'ikibaho cyose. Nta makuru y'ikarita cyangwa igenamiterere ry'ikibaho bihinduka, kandi kongera kuwutoranya byerekana buri kibaho uko cyari giteguwe. Uko imyanya ikurikirana ni ukwa buri kibaho.
cards-loading-auto: Byikora (gutangiza agaragara gusa ku bibaho binini)
cards-loading-description: WeKan itangiza amakarita y'ikibaho mu buryo bwikora: ikibaho kinini (kirengeje ingano ntarengwa) gitangiza gusa amakarita agaragara ubu (gukomeza kumanuka kutagira iherezo) hamwe n'umubare uvugururwa, kugira ngo gikomeze kwihuta kandi gikoreshe ububiko n'umuyoboro bike; ibibaho bito byo bigatangiza buri karita kugira ngo ikoreshwe mu buryo bworoshye kandi bwuzuye. Nta cyo kugena. Abayobozi ba sisitemu bashobora guhatiriza uburyo bakoresheje impinduragaciro za CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) na CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Gutangiza amakarita agaragara gusa biracyageragezwa: ibarura ry'amakarita n'imipaka ya WIP ni byo, ariko imigaragarire ya Calendar/Table/Gantt no guhitamo byinshi byerekana gusa amakarita amaze gutangizwa. Ongera utangize ibibaho bifunguye nyuma yo guhindura ibi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Iyo bikora, amahuza yose (amahuzwa ya markdown nka [label](url) n'utumenyetso twa HTML <a href> mbisi) buri gihe yerekanwa nk'umwandiko usanzwe udakandwa mu mirima yose y'umwandiko ukungahaye (imitwe y'ibibaho n'amakarita, ibisobanuro, ibitekerezo, intonde z'igenzura n'ibindi). Ibi birinda amahuza akandwa ayobya. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze, bityo amahuza agakomeza gukandwa.
always-show-code-as-text: Buri gihe erekana kode yose nk'umwandiko usanzwe
always-show-code-as-text-description: Iyo bikora, umwandiko ukungahaye ntiwerekanwa nka markdown cyangwa HTML: inkomoko yose ihora yerekanwa nk'umwandiko usanzwe mu mirima yose y'umwandiko ukungahaye (imitwe y'ibibaho n'amakarita, ibisobanuro, ibitekerezo, intonde z'igenzura n'ibindi). Ibi bigaragaza ibikubiye byari bihishwe — ibitekerezo bya HTML (<!-- -->), aho amahuza ya markdown yerekeza, JavaScript n'indi kode yose — bityo kode yose igahora igaragara, ntikandwe kandi ntikore. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze, bityo markdown ikerekanwa bisanzwe.
disable-all-import-description: Iyo bikora, uburyo bwose bwo kwinjiza burahagarikwa: kwinjiza ikibaho kivuye muri WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, ndetse no gukoporora ikibaho. Amahitamo yo kwinjiza arahishwa kandi seriveri ikanga ubusabe bwose bwo kwinjiza. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-all-export-description: Iyo bikora, uburyo bwose bwo gusohora burahagarikwa: gusohora ikibaho nka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, cyangwa muri NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, hamwe no gusohora umugereka umwe. Amahitamo yo gusohora arahishwa kandi seriveri ikanga ubusabe bwose bwo gusohora. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-import-avatars-description: Iyo bikora, amashusho y'imyirondoro y'abakoresha ntiyigera yinjizwa. Ibi bireba kwinjiza WeKan JSON, kwinjiza Trello no guhuza amashusho y'imyirondoro aturuka ku batanga umwirondoro bo hanze igihe cyo kwinjira (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Amazina n'andi makuru biracyinjizwa; amashusho y'imyirondoro gusa ni yo asimbukwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-export-avatars-description: Iyo bikora, amashusho y'imyirondoro ntiyigera ashyirwa mu isohora ry'ikibaho (isohora rya WeKan JSON na CSV). Amazina y'abakoresha n'andi makuru biracyasohorwa; amashusho y'imyirondoro gusa ni yo asigara. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
anonymize-import-users-description: Iyo bikora, kwinjiza ikibaho cya WeKan JSON bisimbuza izina ry'ukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'ibanze bya buri ukoresha winjijwe n'ibimenyetso bibarwa (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho ye y'umwirondoro kandi bikongera kwandika @username ivugwa (n'imirima requested-by / assigned-by) mu bikubiye mu makarita no mu bitekerezo byinjijwe. Nta mwirondoro nyakuri w'ukoresha wo ku kibaho cy'inkomoko ubikwa. Ijambo "ukoresha" rikurikiza ururimi rw'umuntu winjiza. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
anonymize-export-users-description: Iyo bikora, gusohora ikibaho bisimbuza izina ry'ukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'ibanze bya buri ukoresha usohorwa n'ibimenyetso bibarwa (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho ye y'umwirondoro kandi bikongera kwandika @username ivugwa (n'imirima requested-by / assigned-by) mu bikubiye mu makarita no mu bitekerezo. Dosiye isohowe nta mwirondoro nyakuri w'ukoresha itwara. Ijambo "ukoresha" rikurikiza ururimi rw'umuntu usohora. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Uzi neza ko ushaka guhisha umwirondoro w'iyi konti? Ibi bisimbuza burundu izina ry'ukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'aderesi ya imeyili n'indangagaciro zihishe, bigakuraho ishusho y'umwirondoro kandi bigahagarika kwinjira. Bitandukanye no gusiba, ibibaho, amakarita n'ibitekerezo bigumana amateka yabyo kandi bigakomeza kwerekana iyi konti, ariko yahishwe umwirondoro. Iki gikorwa ntigishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
disable-activities-description: Iyo bikora, ibyandikwa mu rutonde rw'ibikorwa ntibyigera bibikwa cyangwa ngo byerekanwe ahantu hose (urubari rwo ku ruhande rw'ikibaho n'agace k'ibikorwa by'ikarita). Nta mateka y'uwakoze iki abikwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-notifications-description: Iyo bikora, WeKan ntiyigera yohereza imenyesha zo gukurikirana (muri porogaramu, imeli cyangwa izindi serivisi) ku gikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose. Ibikorwa biracyashobora kwandikwa (keretse na byo byahagaritswe hejuru); imenyesha gusa ni zo zihagarikwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-watch-description: Iyo bikora, uburyo bwo gukurikirana burahagarikwa — abakoresha ntibashobora kwiyandikisha ku bibaho, intonde cyangwa amakarita ngo bahabwe imenyesha, kandi kugerageza guhindura urwego rwo gukurikirana birangwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
backup-description: Bika kopi y'umutekano y'Imigereka, Amashusho y'imyirondoro na/cyangwa Amakuru (amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku mwandiko atari imigereka cyangwa amashusho y'imyirondoro). Dosiye .zip yoherezwa ako kanya mu bubiko bwatoranyijwe — nta dosiye y'agateganyo — nka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, irimo YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Ububiko bwo mu gicu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) bukoresha ibyangombwa byagenwe mu duce twabwo tw'ububiko.
backup-scope-description: Urugero rwose, cyangwa Ikigo kimwe. Kopi y'umutekano y'Ikigo irimo ibibaho byacyo n'ibiri kuri byo byose, harimo imigereka y'ibyo bibaho — ariko nta konti z'abakoresha cyangwa igenamiterere ry'urugero, kuko ibyo bisangiwe n'Ibigo byose. Kugarura kopi y'umutekano y'Ikigo byandika gusa ku bibaho icyo Kigo gifite.

continuous-backup-description: Yohereza buri mpinduka mu bubikoshingiro, mu migereka, mu mashusho y'imyirondoro no mu nyandiko z'ibyabaye mu bubiko bwa dosiye mu masegonda make, kugira ngo amakuru ashobore kugarurwa uko yari ameze igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Ikorana na kopi y'umutekano yateganyirijwe igihe, ikora ububiko bwuzuye.

continuous-backup-engine-none: Nta moteri y'ububikoshingiro ishobora gukora kuri iyi seriveri

blockly-LOGIC_TERNARY_TOOLTIP: Genzura icyangombwa kiri muri 'igerageza'. Niba icyangombwa ari ukuri, isubiza agaciro ka 'niba ari ukuri'; bitabaye ibyo isubiza agaciro ka 'niba ari ikinyoma'.
blockly-MATH_ARITHMETIC_TOOLTIP_DIVIDE: Isubiza igisubizo cyo kugabanya imibare ibiri.
blockly-MATH_ARITHMETIC_TOOLTIP_POWER: Isubiza umubare wa mbere ushyizwe ku gipimo cy'umubare wa kabiri.
blockly-MATH_ATAN2_TOOLTIP: Isubiza arctangent y'akadomo (X, Y) muri dogere kuva kuri -180 kugeza kuri 180.
blockly-MATH_CONSTANT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza imwe mu mibare idahinduka isanzwe: π (3.141…), e (2.718…), φ (1.618…), sqrt(2) (1.414…), sqrt(½) (0.707…), cyangwa ∞ (ibitagira iherezo).
blockly-MATH_CONSTRAIN_TOOLTIP: Garukiriza umubare kugira ngo ube hagati y'imipaka yagenwe (harimo n'iyo mipaka).
blockly-MATH_IS_NEGATIVE: ni umubare uri munsi ya zeru
blockly-MATH_IS_POSITIVE: ni umubare uri hejuru ya zeru
blockly-MATH_IS_TOOLTIP: Genzura niba umubare ari igiharwe, igiharwe-tumbo, umubare w'ibanze, umubare wuzuye, uri hejuru ya zeru, uri munsi ya zeru, cyangwa niba ugabanywa n'umubare runaka. Isubiza ukuri cyangwa ikinyoma.
blockly-MATH_MODULO_TOOLTIP: Isubiza igisigara cyo kugabanya imibare ibiri.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_AVERAGE: Isubiza impuzandengo y'imibare iri ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MAX: Isubiza umubare munini kurusha iyindi ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MEDIAN: Isubiza umubare wo hagati ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MIN: Isubiza umubare muto kurusha iyindi ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MODE: Isubiza urutonde rw'ikintu (ibintu) gikunze kugaragara ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_SUM: Isubiza igiteranyo cy'imibare yose iri ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_FLOAT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza igice cy'impanuka hagati ya 0.0 (harimo) na 1.0 (hatarimo).
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TITLE: umubare wuzuye w'impanuka kuva kuri %1 kugeza kuri %2
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza umubare wuzuye w'impanuka hagati y'imipaka ibiri yagenwe, harimo n'iyo mipaka.
blockly-MINIMAP_ARIA_LABEL: Ikarita ntoya y'aho ukorera. Koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo wimure aho ukorera.
blockly-NO_PARENT_ANNOUNCEMENT: Igice kiriho nta gice gikomokaho gifite
blockly-PASTE_ALL_FROM_BACKPACK: Shyiramo Ibice Byose biri mu Gikapu
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALLRETURN_TOOLTIP: Koresha imikorere '%1' yasobanuwe n'ukoresha kandi ukoreshe igisubizo cyayo.
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALL_DISABLED_DEF_WAR: Ntibishoboka gukoresha imikorere '%1' yasobanuwe n'ukoresha kuko igice cy'isobanura cyahagaritswe.
blockly-PROCEDURES_DEF_DUPLICATE_WARNING: Umuburo: Iyi mikorere ifite ibipimo bisubiramo.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_TOOLTIP: Niba agaciro ari ukuri, subiza agaciro ka kabiri.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_WARNING: Umuburo: Iki gice gishobora gukoreshwa mu isobanura ry'imikorere gusa.
blockly-PROCEDURES_MUTATORCONTAINER_TOOL: Ongeraho, kuraho, cyangwa usubiremo uko ibyinjizwa by'iyi mikorere bikurikirana.
blockly-SCREENREADER_HINT: Koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo ugendagende. Kanda %1 kugira ngo ufungure cyangwa ufunge uburyo bw'usoma ecran.
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_DISABLED: Uburyo bw'usoma ecran burafunze, kanda %1 kugira ngo ubufungure
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_ENABLED: Uburyo bw'usoma ecran burafunguye, kanda %1 kugira ngo ubufunge
blockly-SHORTCUTS_TOGGLE_SCREENREADER_MO: Fungura cyangwa ufunge uburyo bw'usoma ecran
blockly-TEXT_CHANGECASE_TOOLTIP: Isubiza kopi y'umwandiko mu buryo butandukanye bw'inyuguti.
blockly-TEXT_CHARAT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza inyuguti iri ku mwanya wagenwe.
blockly-TEXT_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Bara inshuro umwandiko ugaragara mu wundi mwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_CREATE_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Ongeraho, kuraho, cyangwa usubiremo uko ibice bikurikirana kugira ngo uhindure iki gice cy'umwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_END_FROM_END: kugeza ku nyuguti # uhereye ku iherezo
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FIRST: fata igice cy'umwandiko uhereye ku nyuguti ya mbere
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_EN: fata igice cy'umwandiko uhereye ku nyuguti # uhereye ku iherezo
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_ST: fata igice cy'umwandiko uhereye ku nyuguti #
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_FIRST: shaka aho umwandiko ubonekera bwa mbere
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_LAST: shaka aho umwandiko ubonekera bwa nyuma
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Isubiza umwanya umwandiko wa mbere ubonekeraho bwa mbere/bwa nyuma mu mwandiko wa kabiri. Isubiza %1 niba umwandiko utabonetse.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Isubiza ukuri niba umwandiko watanzwe urimo ubusa.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Kora igice cy'umwandiko uhuza hamwe umubare uwo ari wo wose w'ibintu.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Isubiza umubare w'inyuguti (harimo n'imyanya) ziri mu mwandiko watanzwe.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Andika umwandiko, umubare cyangwa ikindi gaciro byagenwe.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Simbuza aho umwandiko ugaragara hose mu wundi mwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_REVERSE_TOOLTIP: Ihindukiza uko inyuguti zikurikirana mu mwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: kuraho imyanya ku mpande zombi za
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_LEFT: kuraho imyanya ku ruhande rw'ibumoso rwa
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: kuraho imyanya ku ruhande rw'iburyo rwa
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Isubiza kopi y'umwandiko yakuweho imyanya ku mpera imwe cyangwa zombi.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Ishyira iyi mpinduragaciro ku gaciro kangana n'icyinjijwe.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Impinduragaciro yitwa '%1' isanzwe ihari ku bundi bwoko: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Impinduragaciro yitwa '%1' isanzwe ihari nk'igipimo mu mikorere '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Shakisha aho ukorera. Kanda Enter ku gihuye gikurikira, Shift+Enter ku gihuye kibanza. Kanda Escape kugira ngo ufunge ishakisha kandi werekeze ku gihuye kiriho.
r-blocks-help: Huza imbarutso imwe n'igikorwa kimwe. Kurura ibice uvana mu gasanduku k'ibikoresho. Koresha umwanditsi w'ifishi ku mahitamo yisumbuye.
r-blocks-unavailable: Amakuru y'itegeko ntaboneka. Koresha umwanditsi w'ifishi kugira ngo usuzume iri tegeko.
r-blocks-invalid: Huza imbarutso imwe gusa n'igikorwa kimwe. Kuraho ibice bitahujwe cyangwa birenze mbere yo kubika.
r-blocks-conflict: Iri tegeko ryahindutse mu gihe warimo urihindura. Ongera ufungure itegeko ryabitswe mbere yo kubika.
r-blocks-permission: Uruhushya rw'umuyobozi w'ikibaho rurakenewe kugira ngo uhindure amategeko.
scrum-policy-doneLists: Ikarita iri mu rutonde rwo mu cyiciro cya Done
scrum-releases-select-help: Ikarita ishobora kuba mu masohora menshi. Fata Ctrl (Cmd kuri Mac) kugira ngo uhitemo arenze rimwe; yakureho yose kugira ngo ukure ikarita mu masohora yose.
scrum-select-sprint: Hitamo sprint kugira ngo urebe raporo yayo.
scrum-backlog-help: Tondeka akazi hakurikijwe urwego mu bitegereje. Ha amakarita sprint iteganyijwe cyangwa iri gukora.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Nta foto ya sprint yafunzwe iboneka.
scrum-report-help: Raporo zigumana igereranya ryo mu mafoto ya sprint. Igereranya ritazwi ribarwa ukwaryo; si igereranya rya zeru. Gereranya umuvuduko gusa hagati y'ibipimo by'igereranya na politiki bihuye.
scrum-confirm-close: Gufunga iyi sprint no kubika ibyavuyemo? Amakarita atarangiye azimurirwa aho watoranyije.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Guhagarika iyi sprint? Amakarita yayo agumana ubunyamuryango kugeza ahawe ahandi.
scrum-list-category: Icyiciro cy'urujya n'uruza rw'akazi rwa Scrum
scrum-partial-report: Raporo ituzuye: amakarita wahawe ubu gusa ni yo arimo.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Iyi sprint irimo igice gusa cy'ifoto y'umwimerere.
scrum-rollover-progress: Kwimura amakarita ya sprint imbere: __done__ muri __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Gusubiza inyuma cyangwa kongera gukora impinduka nini: __done__ mu mirongo y’amateka __total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Gusubiza inyuma cyangwa kongera gukora impinduka nini byahagaze. Ongera ukande gusubiza inyuma cyangwa kongera gukora kugira ngo ukomeze:
scrum-daily-observations: Ibigize akazi bya buri munsi n'akazi gasigaye (ibyagaragaye)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Buri murongo werekana icyagaragaye cya mbere cyanditswe ku munsi wa UTC, ku isaha yerekanwa. Iminsi ibura ntigaragazwa. Ibi byagaragaye ntibyandika buri mpinduka cyangwa ngo byerekane igiteranyo cyo ku iherezo ry'umunsi. Igereranya ritazwi si zeru. Koresha igikorwa cya Sohora cy'iki gice ku byagaragaye bya buri munsi; igikorwa cya Sohora cyo ku murongo w'ibikoresho gisohora ibyavuye muri sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Ibyagaragaye 366 biheruka gusa ni byo byerekanwa.
scrum-daily-empty: Nta byagaragaye bya buri munsi byanditswe kuri iyi sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Ingano y’akazi n’akazi gasigaye, kuri buri mpinduka
scrum-scope-history-help: Byongeye kubakwa hifashishijwe amateka y’ikibaho kuva sprint itangiye: umurongo umwe kuri buri mpinduka ku makarita ya sprint, ku bigereranyo cyangwa ku kazi karangiye.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Amateka ntashobora kongera gukora ishusho y’imiterere ya sprint ubwayo: impinduka zimwe zakozwe zitanditswe mu mateka, bityo ibi bipimo ntibyuzuye.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Impinduka za mbere gusa ni zo zashoboye gusomwa; kongera kubaka ntibyuzuye.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Nta mpinduka zabaye kuva sprint itangiye.
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Ikarita yashyizwe mu bubiko cyangwa yagaruwe
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Icyagaragaye cya mbere cyanditswe kuri buri munsi wa UTC; iminsi ibura ntigaragazwa. Ibyagaragaye ntibyandika buri mpinduka cyangwa igiteranyo cyo ku iherezo ry'umunsi. Igereranya ritazwi si zeru.
scrum-import-pending: Kwinjiza Scrum ntikurarangira. Guhindura Scrum no gusohora raporo ntibiboneka.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Kwinjiza kwahagaritswe no kongera gutangiza bishobora gusozwa hano nyuma yo guhagarara. Niba gahunda yabyo itarabitswe yose, bishobora gusa guhagarikwa; ibyo nta cyo bihindura ku kibaho.
scrum-import-into-board: Injiza igenamigambi rya Scrum muri iki kibaho
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Hitamo isohora ry'ikibaho cya WeKan cyangwa dosiye yo kwimura Scrum. Sprints n'amasohora iki kibaho gisanzwe gifite birahuzwa, ntibikorerwa kopi. Amakarita ahuzwa hakurikijwe ID, cyangwa nimero y'ikarita n'umutwe; amakarita adahuye arandikwa kandi ntahindurwa. Banza urebe mbere kugira ngo umenye ibizahinduka.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprints: __created__ nshya, __matched__ zisanzwe kuri iki kibaho, __skipped__ zitinjijwe
scrum-import-preview-releases: Amasohora: __created__ mashya, __matched__ asanzwe kuri iki kibaho, __skipped__ atinjijwe
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Nta cyo guhindura: iki kibaho gisanzwe gifite iri genamigambi.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Igenamigambi rya Scrum ryinjijwe kandi ryanditswe mu Mateka.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikarita ihuye n'amakarita arenze imwe kuri iki kibaho: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikarita ni iy'ikindi kibaho kandi ntiyahinduwe: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint cyangwa isohora bihuye n'ibirenze kimwe kuri iki kibaho: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, isohora cyangwa igikorwa ntibyashoboye kwinjizwa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Hitamo agaciro kuri buri kimbirane. Sync yongera kugerageza nyuma ya buri hitamo. Nta kintu cyoherezwa kuri sisitemu y'inkomoko.
sync-conflict-refresh: Ongera ukoreshe Sync kugira ngo usuzume agaciro kariho.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Amakarita wahawe yasuzumwe. Nta makimbirane y'imyanya asigaye. Sync y'urutonde rwose ntiyakozwe.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Kuraho gusa ihuza rya Sync ry'iyi kopi. Ibiyirimo bigumana muri WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Kujyana mu Bubiko byabujijwe n'amakarita mato akiri gukora
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Ikintu cy'inkomoko cyavuyeho, ariko amakarita mato akiri gukora abuza kujyana mu Bubiko. Gumana iyi karita hano ukuraho ihuza ryayo rya Sync. Amakarita mato ntahindurwa.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Gumana ikarita yabanje uko iri maze ukore ikarita nshya ya Sync muri uru rutonde. Kongera kugerageza bikoresha iyo isimbura.
sync-preview-saved: Bishingiye ku igenamiterere ryabitswe. Sync nonaha izana kandi ikongera kugenzura inkomoko.
sync-preview-unavailable: Bika inkomoko ya Sync mbere yo gusaba irebamberere.
sync-preview-blocked: Kemura amakimbirane ari hasi mbere yo gusuzuma igenamigambi ry'impinduka.
sync-preview-scope: Imibare yerekeza ku myanya y'inkomoko yatunganyijwe. Andi makuru ashobora gusigwa n'usesengura inkomoko.
sync-source-heading: Imyanya y'inkomoko idakopororwa mu buryo butaziguye
sync-source-scope: Inzira zishyira hamwe aho imyanya igaragara mu bintu by'inkomoko. Ibintu bidahujwe bitangazwa byose hamwe; agaciro kabyo ntikerekanwa.
sync-source-occurrences: Aho imyanya cyangwa ibintu byagaragaye byatangajwe
sync-source-truncated: Raporo igarukira ku nzira 100 n'amazina y'imyanya yagabanyijwe.
sync-report-partial: Sync zanze cyangwa zitarangiye zishobora kuba zarahinduye amakarita amwe. Izi raporo ntizikomeza cyangwa ngo zisibe Sync.
sync-report-unfinished: Birimo gukorwa cyangwa byahagaze; ibyavuyemo ntibyanditswe
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Byarangiye hari imyanya yasizwe cyangwa yahinduwe
sync-report-unavailable: Raporo za Sync zisaba uburenganzira bwo kwandika ku rutonde rwose na seriveri iboneka.
sync-recovery-description: Raporo za Sync zabitswe zo mu minsi 30 ishize. Shakisha ukoresheje ID y'ikibaho cyangwa y'urutonde. Ibitararangiye bishobora kuba bigikorwa cyangwa byarahagaze. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere urebe; izi raporo ntizishobora gukomeza cyangwa gusiba impinduka.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gusoma isuzuma rya Sync. Genzura uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi n'uko seriveri iboneka.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Hitamo umwanya w'imibare ufite ID y'umwanya wa Jira n'igipimo cy'igereranya, nk'uko wakozwe n'iyinjiza rya Jira ryahujwe. Impinduka zo hano zisuzumwa nk'amakimbirane. Agaciro k'inkomoko kabura kirengagizwa; null yeruye isiba agaciro kahujwe.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Uburemere cyangwa ikigereranyo cy’igihe cya GitLab byandikwa mu mwanya w’imibare wahisemo. Impinduka zo muri sisitemu yawe zisuzumwa nk’amakimbirane; ikibazo kidafite uburemere gisiba agaciro gahujwe na cyo.
email-recovery-description: Umurongo umwe kuri buri wakira. Shakisha ukoresheje ID y'ukoresha. Ibiri mu butumwa n'imyanya ya imeyili y'uwakira ntibyerekanwa. Guhagarika by'akanya bifata ubutumwa busanzwe n'ubuzaza; Gukomeza byongera kugerageza kohereza ubutumwa buri ku murongo ubu. Guhagarika burundu bikuraho ubutumwa bwashyizwe ku murongo kugeza igihe cy'ubusabe. Niba kohereza bikiri gukorwa, ongera ugerageze mu kanya. Ubutumwa bwatangiye koherezwa ntibushobora kugarurwa, kandi kohereza kutazwi neza uko kwagenze gushobora gusubirwamo. Ibitaragenze neza burundu n'ubutumwa bwageze ku mubare ntarengwa w'igerageza bigumaho kugira ngo bisuzumwe. Kongera kugerageza ubutumwa butoherejwe neza bitangira icyiciro gishya cy'igerageza kandi bikomeza kubahiriza ihagarikwa ry'akanya risanzwe.
email-recovery-attempts: Umubare munini kurusha indi wo kongera kugerageza
email-recovery-oldest: Igihe bwashyiriwe ku murongo bwa mbere
email-recovery-cancel: Hagarika burundu ubutumwa buri ku murongo
email-recovery-empty: Nta butumwa buri ku murongo kandi nta bakira bahagarikiwe koherezwa by'akanya.
email-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gusoma umurongo wa imeyili. Reba uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi n'uko seriveri iboneka.
email-recovery-busy: Kohereza cyangwa ikindi gikorwa cy'umurongo birakorwa. Vugurura hanyuma wongere ugerageze mu kanya.
email-recovery-failed: Igikorwa nticyashoboye kwemezwa. Vugurura umurongo kandi wongere ugerageze igikorwa kimwe niba bikenewe.
email-recovery-superseded: Igikorwa gishya cy'ushinzwe ibikorwa cyasimbuye ubu busabe. Harerekanwa uko umurongo umeze ubu.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Guhagarika burundu ubutumwa bwose buri ku murongo ubu bugenewe uyu wakira? Ibirimo bizakurwaho kandi ntibishobora kugarurwa. Ubutumwa bushya bwakozwe nyuma y'ubu busabe buzagumaho.
email-recovery-retry: Ongera ugerageze kohereza ubutumwa butoherejwe neza
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kugeza ntibyashoboye kwemezwa; suzuma mbere yo kongera kugerageza
sync-time-estimate-hint: Igereranya ry'igihe rikoresha imyanya y'imibare y'igihe cy'umwimerere/gisigaye yakozwe n'iyinjiza rya Jira. Hagomba kubaho umwanya umwe gusa uhuye kuri iki kibaho. Impinduka zo hano zisuzumwa nk'amakimbirane; agaciro k'inkomoko kabura kirengagizwa naho null yeruye isiba agaciro.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint n'amasohora bihuzwa gusa iyo Scrum ifunguye kuri iki kibaho. Sprint cyangwa isohora bibura bikorwa kuri iki kibaho, n'amatariki inkomoko itanga; ibisanzwe bihari bihuzwa mbere na mbere hakurikijwe ID y'inkomoko, hanyuma izina. Impinduka y'igenamigambi yo hano igumaho kugeza inkomoko ihinduye igenamigambi ry'icyo kibazo, kandi Sync ya mbere ntijya ikuraho igenamigambi.
activity-recovery-description: Amamenyesha atarangiye yongera kugeragezwa ku buryo bwikora. Suzuma ibikorwa bibura cyangwa byahindutse mbere yo kongera kugerageza. Kongera kugerageza ntikugarura igikorwa.
activity-recovery-busy: Undi mukozi arimo gukemura iri menyesha. Ongera ufungure maze wongere ugerageze.
activity-recovery-denied: Uburenganzira bw'uwakira cyangwa ibyo yahisemo ku mamenyesha ntibikemera kugeza.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Igikorwa cy'umwimerere kirabura cyangwa cyarahindutse. Nta kintu cyongeye gukorwa.
activity-recovery-failed: Ntibishoboka kurangiza kugeza amamenyesha. Akazi gategereje karabitswe.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Iri menyesha ryahindutse kuva ryafungurwa. Suzuma uko rimeze ubu mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Ntibishoboka kwemeza igenamiterere ryo kugeza. Ongera ufungure maze usuzume uko rimeze ubu.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Guhagarika burundu kugeza gusigaye kw'iki gikorwa? Ntibishobora gukomezwa. Imeyili zamaze gushyirwa ku murongo n'amamenyesha yamaze kugezwa ntibigarurwa.
rule-email-recovery-description: Suzuma igerageza ryanditswe ryo kohereza imeri z'amategeko. Igerageza ritaremezwa rishobora kuba rigikomeza kohereza cyangwa ryarahagaritswe. Iyi raporo ntiyongera kohereza kandi ntihagarika kohereza.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Nta gerageza ryo kohereza imeri z'amategeko rihuye n'iri shakisha.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura igerageza rya imeyili z'amategeko. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ntizigera yongera kohereza ubwayo imeri itaremezwa. Kongera kohereza bikorwa ku bakira batararemezwa gusa. Niba uzi ko yageze, shyiraho ko yoherejwe, cyangwa uhagarike kuyohereza.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Kohereza kwa mbere bishobora kuba bigikomeje. Ushobora gufata icyemezo nyuma ya __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Wongere wohereze iyi meri ku bakira batararemezwa? Uwo seriveri ye y'imeri yakiriye ubutumwa ariko ntiyamenyeshe WeKan azabwakira kabiri.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Ushyireho ko iyi meri yoherejwe kuri bose? Kora ibi gusa niba uzi ko yageze.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Uhagarike kohereza iyi meri? Ntizoherezwa ku bakira batararemezwa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Kohereza kwa mbere bishobora kuba bigikomeje. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Kongera kohereza kwabanje bishobora kuba bigikomeje. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Abakira bose bamaze kwemezwa. Ahubwo shyiraho ko yoherejwe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seriveri y'imeri ntiyasubije. Ubutumwa bwongeye koherezwa bushobora kuba bwageze cyangwa butageze; bwerekanwa nk'ubukiri koherezwa.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Undi muyobozi arimo gukemura iyi meri. Ongera ugerageze mu kanya.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeri yabitswe ntikijyanye n'iri gerageza, bityo ntishobora gukemurwa hano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Inyandiko yabitswe y'iri gerageza ntiyemewe, bityo ntishobora gukemurwa hano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Iyi meri ntiyashoboye gukemurwa. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-description: Izi meri z'amategeko zateguwe na verisiyo ya kera ya WeKan itandikaga aho ibizikubiyemo byaturutse, bityo WeKan ntizizohereza ubwayo. Nyuma yo kugenzura ko uwanditse itegeko agifite uburenganzira bwo kugera ku ikarita, ongera uhuze imeri kugira ngo yongere gutegurwa hakurikijwe uko ikarita imeze ubu, cyangwa uyijugunye.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ibisobanuro by'ikarita byo muri verisiyo ya kera
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Wongere utegure iyi meri ukurikije uko ikarita imeze ubu? Ibiyikubiyemo bishobora gutandukana n'ibyateguwe mbere.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Imeri z'amategeko zitegereje gusuzumwa ntizashoboye gufungurwa. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Uwanditse itegeko ntakifite uburenganzira bwo kugera kuri iyi karita, cyangwa itegeko ryarahindutse, bityo imeri ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Igikorwa cyatumye iyi meri itegurwa cyarahindutse, bityo ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ikarita iyi meri yaturutseho ntikiboneka, bityo ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Iyubahirizwa ry'itegeko ryateguye iyi meri ntirikibitswe, bityo ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Iyi meri yamaze koherezwa, hageragejwe kuyohereza, cyangwa yarajugunywe.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Iki gikorwa nticyashoboye kurangira. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Ibikorwa bya Sync y'Urutonde bidashobora kongera gukorwa
stuck-sync-operation-description: Buri gikorwa muri ibi bya Sync y'Urutonde byabitswe cyahagaze kigeze hagati kandi ntigishobora kurangizwa, kuko urutonde rwacyo rwakuweho, rwongeye gukorwa cyangwa rwahinduriwe igenamiterere, cyangwa ukoresha wagitangije yatakaje uburenganzira bwo kwandika. Mu gihe kimwe gitegereje, urwo rutonde ntirushobora gukora Sync. Gikureho kugira ngo urutonde rwongere rukore Sync: impinduka zamaze gushyirwamo zigumaho, impinduka zisigaye zabitswe ntizizigera zandikwa, kandi Sync ikurikira yongera kugereranya urutonde n'inkomoko yarwo.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Urutonde rwakuweho, rwongeye gukorwa cyangwa igenamiterere ryarwo rya Sync ryarahindutse
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Ukoresha wagitangije ntakigira uburenganzira bwo kwandika ku rutonde rwose
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Cyabitswe na verisiyo ya WeKan ya kera hatanditswe icyagitangije
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Gishobora kongera gukorwa ubu kandi kizirangiza ubwacyo, bityo ntigishobora gukurwaho.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Gukuraho iki gikorwa cya Sync y'Urutonde cyabitswe? Impinduka cyamaze gushyiramo zigumaho; izisigaye ntizizigera zandikwa. Urutonde ruzashobora kongera gukora Sync.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Nta bikorwa bya Sync y'Urutonde bitegereje gusuzumwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: 50 bya kera cyane gusa ni byo byerekanwa. Kuraho bimwe maze wongere ufungure kugira ngo ubone ibindi.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura ibikorwa bya Sync y'Urutonde. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere ugerageze.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Iki gikorwa ntikiraboneka ko cyahagaze, bityo ntigishobora gukurwaho.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Iki gikorwa gishobora kongera gukorwa ubu kandi kizirangiza ubwacyo, bityo nticyakuweho.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Uru rutonde rurimo gukora Sync ubu. Ongera ugerageze mu kanya.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Iki gikorwa nticyashoboye kurangira. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
interrupted-import-description: Buri kwinjiza ikibaho muri aya kwahagaze kugeze hagati - seriveri yongeye gutangira, cyangwa kwinjiza kwanze - kandi kwasize ikibaho kituzuye. Kwinjiza ntikushobora gukomezwa, kuko dosiye y'inkomoko yako itabikwa. Gumana ikibaho uko kiri, cyangwa ugikureho maze wongere winjize dosiye. Gukuraho bisiba ikibaho uku kwinjiza kwakoze n'ibikiriho byose, harimo n'ibyacyongeweho nyuma.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Birimo gukurwaho; ongera ukureho kugira ngo birangire
interrupted-import-scrum: Icyiciro cyako cya Scrum gifite aho kibikirwa hacyo (__state__, intambwe __next__ kuri __total__). Niba ugumanye ikibaho, rangiza cyangwa ukureho uvuye mu kugarura iyinjiza rya Scrum ry'ikibaho.
interrupted-import-counts: Imirongo __swimlanes__, intonde __lists__, amakarita __cards__, intonde zo kugenzura __checklists__, ibitekerezo __comments__, imigereka __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Gumana iki kibaho kituzuye uko kiri? Nta kintu gikurwaho, kandi kwinjiza ntikuzongera kugaragara hano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Gukuraho uku kwinjiza? Ikibaho kwakoze n'ibikiriho byose bisibwa burundu.
interrupted-import-empty: Nta kwinjiza ibibaho kwahagaze gutegereje gusuzumwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: 50 bya kera cyane gusa ni byo byerekanwa. Gumana cyangwa ukureho bimwe maze wongere ufungure kugira ngo ubone ibindi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura kwinjiza ibibaho kwahagaze. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere ugerageze.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Ikibaho gifite iyi id ntikyakozwe n'uku kwinjiza, bityo nticyakozweho.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Icyiciro cyako cya Scrum kiracyandikwa cyangwa kigarurwa. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.
interrupted-import-failed: Iki gikorwa nticyashoboye kurangira. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
saml-login-not-started: Uku kwinjira ukoresheje SAML ntikwatangiriye muri iyi tabi ya mushakisha. Ongera winjire.
history-request-pending-undo: Seriveri ntiremeza gusubiza inyuma impinduka yawe ya nyuma.
history-request-pending-redo: Seriveri ntiremeza kongera gukora impinduka yawe ya nyuma.
history-request-hint: Kongera kugerageza bisubiramo ubusabe bumwe, bityo ntibishobora na rimwe gusubiza inyuma indi mpinduka.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Gusiba, gusubiramo cyangwa kugarura impinduka za Scrum byahagaze kubera amakimbirane. Guhindura Scrum kuri iki kibaho birabujijwe kugeza bikemuwe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Impinduka __applied__ kuri __total__ zanditswe, __pending__ ntizanditswe, naho __conflicted__ zahinduwe n'undi muntu kuva icyo gihe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Gusubiza inyuma bisubiza buri nyandiko yahindutse uko yari iri mbere; bitangwa gusa iyo nta wundi wahinduye izo nyandiko kuva icyo gihe. Kugumana ikibaho uko kiri bikuraho igikorwa cyahagaze kandi ntibihindura inyandiko. Uko byagenda kose, byandikwa mu Buyobozi, Ibibazo, Kugarura.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Gumana buri nyandiko uko iri ubu, harimo n'impinduka igikorwa cyahagaze cyamaze kwandika?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashobora kubisubiza inyuma cyangwa kugumana ikibaho uko kiri.
login-setting-after-restart: Bitangira gukora nyuma yo kongera gutangiza WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Ibidukikije bya seriveri gusa ni byo bishyiraho ibi. Byerekanwa hano ku buryo bwo gusoma gusa.
email-to-card-description: Imeyili yoherejwe kuri aderesi y'ikibaho cyawe ihinduka ikarita kuri icyo kibaho.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook yinjira y'utanga imeyili (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark cyangwa MIME relay idatunganyijwe)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Byabitswe - siga ubusa kugira ngo rigumeho
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Agasanduku k'iposita ka IMAP ko gusoma
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Ikibaho imeyili yoherejwe kuri iyi grain ijyaho
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Nta na kimwe - imeyili zifite ikimenyetso cy'ikibaho mu ngingo gusa
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Shyira ibi mu ngingo kugira ngo ugere kuri iki kibaho mu izina ryawe:
email-to-card-address-private: Yigumane mu ibanga: uwo ari we wese uyifite ashobora kongeraho amakarita mu izina ryawe.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ntiyafunguye imeyili kuri iki kibaho.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Wazimije aderesi z'ibibaho byawe mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ntiragira aderesi imeyili yayo. Ongera ufungure urupapuro.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Ukeneye uburenganzira bwo kwandika kuri iki kibaho.
inbound-domain-invalid: Iryo si izina rya domeni ryemewe.
inbound-account-invalid: Agasanduku k'iposita ka IMAP gakeneye izina rya seriveri ryemewe.
feature-views-email-desc: Ikibaho nk'agasanduku k'iposita: urutonde rw'imeyili ni Izinjiye, intonde ni ububiko, ibirango ni ibirango, abanyamuryango bandika kandi basubiza imeyili bakoresheje aderesi y'ikibaho.
email-view-not-receiving: Iki kibaho ntikirakira imeyili. Gifungure mu Igenamiterere ry'imenyesha ry'ikibaho → Imeyili ijya ku ikarita.
email-view-invalid-address: Imwe muri aderesi si aderesi y'imeyili yemewe.
email-view-too-many: Imeyili nyinshi cyane zoherejwe mu isaha ishize. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
feature-views-chat-desc: Ikibaho nk'umwanya w'ikiganiro: imyanya y'akazi, ibibaho, imirongo, intonde n'amakarita nk'igiti cy'imiyoboro, ikarita hagati n'ibitekerezo byayo nk'ubutumwa bw'ikiganiro.
chat-view-pick-card: Hitamo ikarita mu miyoboro kugira ngo uyibone hano.
chat-view-no-messages: Nta butumwa buraba. Andika ubwa mbere.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Amakarita amwe mu matsinda menshi y'inkingi afite amazina - hakurikijwe kurangira, ibyihutirwa, intambwe cyangwa ikindi icyo ari cyo cyose - yimurwa hagati y'inkingi uyakurura.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Amategeko atanga amategeko ashingiye ku byo abantu bakora n'intoki kenshi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Incamake yerekana ibyo buri muntu yakoze ku kibaho ku munsi cyangwa mu cyumweru giheruka, n'ibyarengeje igihe.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Kuva wasura ubwa nyuma herekana ibyo abandi bahinduye ku kibaho.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Gushakisha hose kumva interuro nka "amakarita yanjye yarengeje igihe".
column-sets-empty: Nta matsinda y'inkingi arahari. Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashobora gukora rimwe: urihe izina, hanyuma wongereho inkingi zaryo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Ikibaho nk'ikurikirana ry'ibibazo bya GitHub cyangwa Gitea: amakarita nk'ibibazo, ibirango n'intambwe, ibitekerezo nk'ikiganiro, imigereka nka dosiye, n'amateka y'ikibaho hamwe no gusubiza inyuma.
vcs-no-milestones: Nta ntambwe irahari. Ikirango gifite itariki ntarengwa ni intambwe.
vcs-no-list: Iki kibaho nta rutonde cyangwa inzira gifite ku kibazo.
card-qr-code-desc: Yisikane kugira ngo ufungure iyi karita kuri telefoni cyangwa tabuleti.
card-qr-code-too-long: Ihuza ry'iyi karita ni rirerire cyane kuri kode ya QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Nta wiki iraboneka. Kwinjiza ikigo cya GitHub bizana hano wiki y'ububiko bwa kode.
github-org-import-desc: Buri bubiko bwa kode bw'ikigo cyangwa bw'ukoresha buhinduka ikibaho cyabwo, gifunguwe muri Board View / Version Control: ibibazo byabwo n'ibitekerezo, ibirango n'amadosiye byabyo, ibisohowe byabwo, imigendekere y'akazi ya GitHub Actions nk'Amategeko, na wiki yabwo.
github-org-import-token-hint: Irakenewe ku bubiko bwigenga no ku rugero rwa API rwisumbuye. Ikoreshwa gusa igihe kwinjiza birimo gukorwa kandi ntibikwa na rimwe.
github-org-import-actions: Imigendekere y'akazi ya GitHub Actions nk'Amategeko
github-org-import-result: Ibibazo %s, ibisohowe %s, amategeko %s, impapuro za wiki %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Andika izina ry'ikigo cyangwa ry'ukoresha, cyangwa aderesi yaryo ya GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: API za REST zifite isura ya API z'izindi sisitemu zikurikirana ibibazo, kugira ngo porogaramu zazo n'inyandiko-porogaramu zazo zishobore gukoresha iyi WeKan nk'inyuma yazo: ibyo zibika bibikwa muri WeKan, ku bibaho bya WeKan. Buri imwe irafunze kugeza ishyizweho akamenyetso hano. Nta n'imwe ifite uburenganzira bwayo bwite: umukiliya yinjira akoresheje token ya API ya WeKan, kandi ashobora kubona no guhindura gusa ibyo uwo muntu ashobora kubona no guhindura muri WeKan. Zose zisaba ko REST API ya WeKan iba ifunguye (WITH_API=true). Aderesi iri munsi ya buri imwe ni yo umukiliya akoresha nka seriveri ye.
optional-api-trello-desc: Porogaramu n'inyandiko-porogaramu zandikiwe REST API ya Trello (urugero Trellinator) zikora na WeKan: ibibaho, intonde, amakarita, ibirango, abanyamuryango, ibitekerezo n'intonde zo kugenzura. Token ya Trello ni token ya API ya WeKan. Gusiba ikarita biyijyana mu bubiko muri WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Abakiliya ba REST API v2 ya Jira bakora na WeKan: umushinga ni ikibaho (urufunguzo rwawo ni urufunguzo rw'ikibaho), ikibazo ni ikarita (DEV-7), imimerere ni urutonde, kandi inzibacyuho yimura ikarita. Gushakisha byakira JQL yoroshye: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Injira ukoresheje token ya API ya WeKan nk'ijambo ry'ibanga. Gusiba ikibazo bikijyana mu bubiko.
optional-api-github-desc: Abakiliya ba REST API ya GitHub y'ibibazo bakora na WeKan: ububiko bwa kode ni ikibaho, ikibazo ni ikarita, gifite ibirango, intambwe (ibirango bifite itariki ntarengwa), ibitekerezo, kandi gifunguye cyangwa gifunze nko muri Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara / Igenzura ry'amaverisiyo. Token ni token ya API ya WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Abakiliya ba REST API ya Gitea na Forgejo y'ibibazo bakora na WeKan, kimwe na API ihuye na GitHub: ububiko bwa kode ni ikibaho kandi ikibazo ni ikarita. Token ni token ya API ya WeKan.
bots-none: Nta robo ziraba. Robo ni igikoresho gikora kuri seriveri yawe bwite - umukozi wa AI, akazi ka CI, inyandiko-porogaramu - iki kibaho giha amakarita.
bot-not-found: Iyo robo ntiri kuri iki kibaho.
bot-option-not-found: Icyo gisubizo si kimwe mu byo robo yatanze.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks zisohoka ntizishobora kugera kuri aderesi ziri ku murandasi bwite wa WeKan, kugira ngo hatagira umuntu werekeza webhook y'ikibaho kuri serivisi y'imbere. Andika hano host ziri kuri uwo murandasi webhooks zemerewe kugeraho - Node-RED, seriveri y'ibiganiro - imwe ku murongo, nk'izina cyangwa aderesi, hamwe n'icyambu kugira ngo hemererwe icyo cyambu gusa. Ubusa: nta na kimwe. Abayobozi b'urubuga bonyine ni bo bashobora guhindura uru rutonde.
account-webhook-desc: Aderesi imwe WeKan imenyesha iyo umuntu yinjiye cyangwa konti nshya ikozwe. Nta kintu cyoherezwa kugeza igikorwa kiri hasi gishyizweho akamenyetso. Itwara igikorwa, izina ry'ukoresha n'igihe; shyira akamenyetso ku yindi myanya ari uko uwakira ayikeneye gusa.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Hagarika amamenyesha yose ategereje y'ibikorwa bimaze iminsi ingahe?
vcs-synced-from: Byahujwe biturutse kuri %s: bifungure kandi ubifunge aho.
vcs-synced-issue: Iki kibazo kirahujwe: gifungure kandi ugifunge mu gikurikirana cyacyo.
sync-write-back: Andika impinduka usubize kuri GitLab: umutwe, ibisobanuro, ibitekerezo, gufunga no kongera gufungura
email-bounces-description: Ibyo WeKan ikora ku meli zigaruka: aderesi yanditswe nabi, agasanduku kuzuye, igisubizo cy'uko umuntu adahari, ikirego cya spam. Ubwoko bwose bufite ibikorwa byabwo, bikorwa iyo bwagarutse inshuro nk'izo.
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Guhagarika kohereza imeli kuri iyo aderesi
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Aderesi ntibaho: ikosa ryo kwandika, konti yasibwe, domeni itazwi.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ntiyagezeyo ubu: agasanduku kuzuye, seriveri irahuze. Izinshi zikurikiranye gusa ni zo zivuga ikintu.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Ibisubizo by'uko adahari, ari mu kiruhuko cyangwa by'uburyo bw'amatike. Imeli yageze.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Uwakiriye yashyize imeli mu za spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Muri Amazon SES, ohereza amatangazo ya Bounce na Complaint, n'itegeko ryo kwakira rya aderesi WeKan yoherezaho, ku nsanganyamatsiko ya SNS, hanyuma wiyandikishe iyi aderesi kuri yo ukoresheje HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN z'insanganyamatsiko za SNS zemewe, imwe ku murongo
email-bounces-clear-hint: Kwibagirwa ibigaruka by'iyi aderesi no kongera kuyoherereza imeli
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Icyo si ARN y'insanganyamatsiko ya SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Niba WeKan yohereza inyuze kuri imwe muri izi serivisi, yifungure, uhe iyo serivisi iyi aderesi ya webhook ku byabaye byayo bya meli zagarutse n'ibirego bya spam, hanyuma ushyire hano urufunguzo isinyisha, cyangwa ijambobanga washyize muri aderesi nka https://user:password@… cyangwa ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Serivisi ifunguye ikeneye urufunguzo rwayo rwo gusinya cyangwa ijambobanga.
activity-pub-enabled: Ibibaho rusange bitangaza ibikorwa by'amakarita yabyo kuri fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Bisanzwe bifunze. Iyo bifunguye, buri kibaho rusange gishobora gukurikirwa kuva kuri Mastodon n'izindi seriveri za fediverse nka @board-<id> kuri aderesi y'iyi WeKan, kandi ibikorwa bishya by'amakarita bigera ku bagikurikira. Ni ibyo gusoma gusa: nta kintu seriveri ya fediverse yohereza gihindura ikibaho, kandi ibibaho bwite ntibitangazwa na rimwe.
caldav-sync-desc: Shyira amatariki ntarengwa y'amakarita y'iki kibaho muri kalendari - Nextcloud Calendar cyangwa kalendari iyo ari yo yose ya CalDAV. Itariki ntarengwa yimuriwe muri kalendari isubira ku ikarita. Koresha ijambobanga rya porogaramu, si iryawe bwite.
caldav-invalid-url: Aderesi ya kalendari igomba kuba aderesi ya http:// cyangwa https://, nta zina ry'ukoresha cyangwa ijambobanga birimo.
caldav-not-linked: Banza ubike aderesi ya kalendari kandi ufungure guhuza.
webdav-storage-description: Bika imigereka mu bubiko bwa dosiye kuri seriveri ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud cyangwa indi iyo ari yo yose. Koresha ijambobanga rya porogaramu ryakorewe WeKan. Seriveri iri ku muyoboro wa WeKan ubwayo ishobora gukoreshwa hano, kuko umuyobozi w'urubuga wenyine ari we ushyiraho iyi aderesi.
sqrl-desc: Bisanzwe bizimije. Iyo bifunguwe, urupapuro rwo kwinjira rutanga SQRL, kandi abanyamuryango babanza kongeraho umwirondoro wabo wa SQRL mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango. SQRL ikenera ko WeKan iba kuri aderesi ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Sikana kode ukoresheje porogaramu yawe ya SQRL, cyangwa ufungure umukiriya wawe wa SQRL kuri iki gikoresho.
sqrl-expired: Iyi kode ya SQRL yarangiye. Ongera utangire.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL ikenera ko WeKan iba kuri aderesi ya https://.
sqrl-description: Injira ukoresheje umwirondoro wawe wa SQRL aho gukoresha ijambobanga. Wongereho hano rimwe ukoresheje umukiriya wawe wa SQRL; ushobora kuwukuraho hano igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kwinjira ukoresheje SQRL kuri iyi konti byahagaritswe n'umukiriya wawe wa SQRL. Bisubize ho aho ngaho ukoresheje kode yawe yo gutabara.
sqrl-only-on: Umukiriya wawe wa SQRL yafunze iyi konti kuri SQRL gusa: ubundi buryo bwose bwo kwinjira buranzwe.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Umukiriya wawe wa SQRL yafunze iyi konti burundu: gusubiramo ijambobanga no guhindura imeyili biranzwe.
